What is HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment 2026?

The recruitment is conducted through Online Recruitment Application (ORA) by Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q1. What is HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification for 23 Agriculture Development Officer Group-A (Job Trainee) posts in the Agriculture Department of Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HPPSC ADO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 23 Agriculture Development Officer vacancies are available under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 22 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HPPSC ADO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have B.Sc. Agriculture under a four-year degree programme and M.Sc. Agriculture 2nd Class from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years as on 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer?
faq.answer: Selected Job Trainees will receive ₹29,500 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HPPSC ADO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Screening Test/Subject Aptitude Test and Personality Test.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for HPPSC Agriculture Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the HPPSC Online Recruitment Application (ORA) portal.
